items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07
items.q: I know Edna, myself and Dalla, we sing the blues all the time.

ctx.x: They all got beautiful voice. Beautiful voice. They said it here. All of them, Ida, they all got nice voice. They all had nice voice. They said it was the best. I mean, you know.

See, they more sing that, uh, channel voice, like you know, all the nice songs, you know, really nice, sentimental songs like that. He didn't sing no variety blues. That's everything I ever did, like singing about blues. Yeah, but I mean Sadie. No, Sadie never sing no blues. Sadie never sing no blues. Sadie never sing no blues. Sadie and Ida never cared about singing any blues. They never did. But Edna, Dalla and myself, we love blues. I love to sing blues. That's true. I don't believe Ida and Sadie can sing…

Well, you ought to get your sisters to sing blues here in the town. Maybe make some recordings of them. They not here. Well, they might pass by to see you sometime. You never know. Nobody left but Edna, huh? No, I have three. I know, but I mean they sing the blues. Edna, Edna's the only one.
